name: tovuize-site
description: Converts an existing static website (plain HTML/CSS/JS, no Tovu, no CMS) into a Tovu static-tier theme. Encodes the theme-format rules a generic HTML-to-CMS port gets wrong: apiVersion 2's render/pages+render/partials+css/theme.css+scripts layout, which of tokens.json/tokens.light.json holds which palette regardless of the source's own default, the publishedPages allow-list that leaves every non-index page unreachable until explicitly turned on, the narrow href=/src= sentinel rewrite that never touches a JS fetch() call, and the hard boundary around binary assets that no agent tool in this product can copy. No new tools — the whole conversion runs on fs_read_file/fs_list_files plus the existing theme_* file tools.
author: Tovu
